description: The Slack workspaces this brand added the Hermoso app to, and the channels in one of them (public, plus private ones the app was invited to with /invite @Hermoso), with the default channel marked. Use it before posting when the user has not named a channel, and to show them the choice. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

slackWorkspace.description: which workspace (id or name) when there are several
